name: CreateOpportunity
label: Create Opportunity
description: Creates a new opportunity in Salesforce.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: The credential to connect with (JSON containing InstanceUrl, AccessToken, ApiVersion).

fields.name: CloseDate
fields.label: Close Date
fields.description: The close date of the opportunity (required).

fields.name: StageNameOrId
fields.label: Stage Name or ID
fields.description: The stage of the opportunity (e.g., 'Prospecting', 'Closed Won').

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Additional field-value pairs to set on the opportunity (e.g., AccountId, Amount).

fields.name: OpportunityId
fields.label: Opportunity ID
fields.description: The ID of the created opportunity.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Salesforce.
